name: Acid Splash
description: Corrosive splash that applies acid.

name: Alpha Howl
description: Commanding howl that fortifies packmates.

name: Arc Spark
description: Arcing spark that shocks the target.

name: Arm Detach
description: Detaches an arm for explosive damage.

name: Barrier Field
description: Projects an active riot barrier, blocking incoming frontal attacks until guard broken.

name: Burrow
description: Dives underground to avoid attacks.

name: Dim Glow
description: Dulls the target with draining light.

name: Dissolve Armor
description: Acidic spray that weakens armor.

name: Drill Lunge
description: Charges forward with drilling claws.

name: Ember Stride
description: Leaves burning embers in its wake.

name: Headshot
description: Deal 150% ATK as piercing damage.

name: Glimmer Dust
description: Irritating dust that lowers defenses.

name: Gnaw
description: A vicious bite attack.

name: Hydraulic Overheat
description: Overclocks systems raising power and bracing armor.

name: Core Repair
description: Reroutes power to seal damaged plating.

name: Seismic Bore
description: A lightning-charged drill strike.

name: Caustic Cutter
description: Cuts with a corrosive spray.

name: Incinerator Burst
description: Blasts a cone of flame.

name: Clamp Crush
description: Crushes the target with a stunning clamp.

name: Lightning Weakpoint
description: Targets exposed weak points with electricity.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Increases evasion by 15% for 2 turns.

name: Overheat
description: Builds up heat to empower systems.

name: Crystalline Spike
description: Razor-sharp crystal spike that weakens foes.

name: EMP Burst
description: Discharges an electromagnetic pulse that disrupts suit optics and targeting.

name: Self Repair
description: Repairs structural damage.

name: Slag Nova
description: Explosive burst of molten slag.

name: Acid Spit
description: Hurls corrosive bile that covers the target in acid.

name: Slide Slam
description: Slides forward and slams into the target.

name: Slingshot
description: A well-aimed shot from Ollie's trusty slingshot.

name: Sonic Shriek
description: Shrill cry that briefly disrupts suit optics, reducing accuracy for one turn.

name: Split
description: Attempts to split and redirect damage.

name: Static Burst
description: Releases stored static electricity to weaken weapon output.

name: Suppressive Fire
description: Burst of covering fire to pin foes.

name: Toxic Bite
description: Envenoms the target with toxic saliva.

name: Triple Burst
description: Sequential burst shots.

name: Undermine
description: Undermines footing with a precision blast.

name: Unstable Pillars
description: Shakes the cavern with collapsing pillars.

name: Volatile Swell
description: Charges up volatile gases to empower attacks.

name: Arc Tether
description: Lashes a high-voltage wire between target and ground, dealing lightning damage and applying Shock.

name: Cryo Vent
description: Purges pressurized coolant through the cutter shroud, freezing armor plates and applying Brittle for 2 turns. Physical attacks deal +50% damage to Brittle targets.

name: Plasma Burst
description: Overdrives the cutter nozzle to hose the enemy formation in superheated gas, triggering Meltdown.

name: Rend Round
description: A barbed flechette round calibrated to bite deep into armor seams. Deals massive bonus damage and Bleed against staggered targets.

name: Shatter Blow
description: A heavy pneumatic piston strike that fractures enemy armor and applies Weak.

name: Bulwark Stance
description: Plants magnetic boots and locks reinforced forearm plates into place, granting Guard and Braced.

name: Overload Fists
description: Shorts maintenance capacitors through his gauntlets, delivering a concussive jolt that shocks the target.

name: Quake Slam
description: Slams the deck with full pneumatic force, sending a shockwave across the enemy line that applies Weak, with devastating bonus damage against stunned targets.

name: Prism Lance
description: Channels coherent harmonic light through a focusing crystal, delivering an armor-piercing beam.

name: Nano Repair
description: Deploys an aerosol of medical nanites that knit flesh and seal torn suits over time.

name: Disruption Pulse
description: Emitters pulse an inverted resonance wave that scrambles targeting sensors and leaves all foes Weakened.

name: Stasis Field
description: Generates a localized cryogenic dampening sphere that flash-freezes the opposing vanguard.

name: Venom Edge
description: Coats a vibroblade in caustic slag runoff, carving open armor seams and leaving lingering Erosion.

name: System Crash
description: Injects an overload virus into target kinetic systems, shutting down their response loop with Stun.

name: Shadow Flurry
description: Steps through blind spots in a blur of blade strikes, leaving the entire enemy squad Bleeding.

name: Blast Wave
description: Unleashes a concussive pulse of raw Source kinetic energy, shattering Guard across all enemies and inflicting Stun.

name: Signal Jammer
description: Floods tactical frequencies with screeching white noise, silencing automated systems and confusing organic targets.

name: Hydraulic Kick
description: A reinforced work-boot strike powered by pressurized pneumatic servos. Shatters enemy Guard and leaves the target Weakened.

name: Pulse Grenade
description: Lobs a repurposed acoustic excavation charge into the enemy squad, dealing physical concussive damage and Staggering the formation.

name: Riot Shield
description: Raises a heavy riot barrier, fortifying defensive posture and bracing against frontal assaults.

name: Drone Support Protocol
description: Deploys an automated combat drone that strafes the party with electric pulse fire, shorting out tech.

name: Gas Grenade
description: Fills the area with choking gas.

name: Emergency Overclock
description: Bypasses armor safety limiters and vents reactor heat, entering an enraged Overdrive state.

name: Flashbang
description: A blinding flash that lowers accuracy.

name: Scrap Shot
description: Fires a rapid spray of jagged slag debris from the cutter muzzle. Fast and dependable, but lacks armor penetration.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Kicks up a blinding flurry of metal filings into the target's optics, lowering enemy accuracy and granting bonus Evasion.

name: Synergy Pitch
description: Hurls a deployable hard-light emitter, anchoring an auxiliary kinetic Barrier around a frontline ally.

name: Stasis Stitch
description: Directs a tether of repair nanites to stitch torn flesh and weave an emergency sub-dermal shield.

name: Target Lock
description: Paints the enemy's structural seams with a targeting laser, drastically boosting critical strike vulnerability while raising personal defenses.

name: Slide Kick
description: Drops low across the metal grating to sweep the target's legs or treads, shattering Guard and causing Stagger.

name: Pounce
description: A rapid pouncing attack that catches the target off-guard.

name: Toxic Spore
description: Spits a ball of venomous moss that weakens the target.

name: Relic Strike
description: A heavy strike with an ancient relic blade, staggering the opponent.

name: Constrict
description: Entangles and constricts the target, weakening them.

name: Nature Heal
description: Draws nutrients from the surrounding soil to restore health.

name: Resonance Beam
description: Fires a concentrated beam of sound energy that blinds the target.

name: Claw Swipe
description: A heavy swipe from massive razor-sharp claws.

name: Roar of the Source
description: A deafening roar that echoes the chaotic currents of the Source.

name: Seismic Stomp
description: Stomps the ground, triggering shockwaves that stagger the team.

name: Baton Strike
description: Enforcer baton strike that shocks and stuns the target.

name: Intercept
description: Gh0st braces himself with Guard: halves incoming damage and prevents stagger for 1 turn.

name: Scan
description: Use the Lens to reveal hidden routes and expose enemy harmonic weaknesses.

name: Phase Counter
description: Gh0st uses the override key discipline to counter an incoming strike and mark the attacker.

name: Construct
description: Use the Anvil to shape Source intent into a temporary barrier or strike.

name: Harden
description: Gh0st hardens his stance with Phantom combat data, gaining Guard, Shield, and Braced stability.

name: Corporate Insight
description: While Nova is above half HP, grants +10 percentage points of accuracy and critical chance.

name: Sunbeam
description: Orion focuses stored solar energy into a burning Source beam.

name: Stasis
description: Use the Anchor to freeze a target in a fixed moment, stopping even self-repairing machines.

name: Data Shield
description: While Zeke is alive, protects the party from hostile Silence, Jammed, and Short Circuit statuses.

name: Legacy
description: While Nova is below half HP, grants +15 percentage points of accuracy and critical chance.

name: Unshackled
description: Grants Zeke +3 Agility and +2 Speed.

name: Source Balance
description: Grants Gh0st +5 flat damage reduction and 25% Source resistance.

name: Ancestral Grace
description: Orion begins each battle with Regen for three turns.

name: Tune World
description: Open the Starborn circuit and rewrite one catastrophic resonance through collective intent.

name: Glitch Bolt
description: A corrupted projectile that disrupts timing and focus.

name: Guilt
description: A memory weapon that turns regret into silence.

name: Compliance Beam
description: A precise Source beam that punishes deviation.

name: Recalibrating Weapons
description: The Avatar recalibrates its weapons after the missile barrage, leaving a brief opening to attack or heal.

name: Gathering Silence
description: The Ascended gathers its fractured voices. A brief opening before the next assault.

name: Great Silence
description: A room-wide collapse toward one voice.

name: Reality Break
description: The Ascended fractures local physical law into a Source detonation.

name: Guardian Covenant
description: Apply Shield and Braced across the party through the recovered guardian bus.

name: Link
description: Restore party HP and apply Regen through the Bridge ground. Does not share damage.

name: Shadow Chorus
description: Summons hostile impressions of the Starborn circuit.

name: Stun Pulse
description: Discharges an ionizing pulse that disorients targets.

name: Evasive Maneuver
description: Executes rapid thruster bursts to avoid incoming attacks.

name: Critical Lunge
description: Strikes precisely at vital weak points.

name: Smoke Step
description: Deploys a dense vapor canister and shifts position.

name: Flame Sweep
description: Sweeps a wide cone of high-temperature fire across the field.

name: Guard Protocol
description: Hardens internal alloy plating to mitigate damage.

name: Mandatory Happiness
description: Broadcasts high-frequency neuro-compliance signals.

name: Deploy Drone
description: Launches automated support drones into the battle space.

name: Laser Lattice
description: Fires an intersecting grid of high-intensity cutting lasers.

name: Heat Burst
description: Vents thermal energy in a rapid radial shockwave.

name: Field Weld
description: Repairs the welder's squad. Its portable repair spool supports only two uses per battle.

name: Slag Shell Cooling
description: The golem opens its overheated slag shell, sacrificing its action and armor while it cools.

name: Molten Slam
description: Brings down a superheated fist infused with boiling slag.

name: Torch Cut
description: Applies an industrial plasma cutter directly to armor plating.

name: Death Burst
description: Detonates overloaded internal power cells in a violent blast.

name: Flame Cone
description: Unleashes an incinerating jet of pressurized liquid fuel.

name: Armor Lock
description: Magnifies inertial stabilizers to completely lock defense plates in place.

name: Phase Slash
description: Blinks through spatial distortion to deliver a frictionless cut.

name: Cloak Step
description: Activates optical cloaking fields to evade counter-attacks.

name: Rhythm Slam
description: Times a devastating pneumatic hammer strike with conveyor cadence.

name: Missile Barrage
description: Fires a swarm of high-explosive micro-missiles.

name: Vent Heat
description: Purges thermal exhausts, exposing core radiators briefly.

name: Titan Stomp
description: Brings down monolithic hydraulic legs, fracturing the ground.

name: Armor Recovery
description: The Warden resets his weapon and vents his armor, leaving a safe response window.

name: Reposition
description: Repositions without attacking, leaving time to respond.

name: Mineral Exhale
description: Exhales a mineral cloud at the announced target, then opens its carapace.

name: Moss Carapace
description: Closes its moss plates for one personal turn.

name: Resonant Dive
description: Commits to the previously announced dive; its mist membrane falls afterward.

name: Mist Membrane
description: Forms a short-lived mist membrane before committing to a dive.

name: Spore Release
description: Releases a swelling spore sac at its announced target. Weakness has a finite duration.

name: Thorn Coil
description: A coiled tendril weakens one victim. Damaging the vine while it coils interrupts the attempt.

name: Root Shelter
description: Anchors once to shelter the plant formation for one personal turn.

name: Root Reserve
description: Spends one of two root reserves to restore the plant formation. Exhausted reserves do not return.

name: Stone Ward
description: Braces its stone ward once. Its joints become exposed after the committed strike.

name: Exposed Recovery
description: Recovers with exposed joints, reducing defense until its next personal turn.

name: Iris Discharge
description: Discharges at the declared target after its iris charge. Does not blind or disable the whole crew.

name: Hunting Lunge
description: A heavy committed lunge at the prey identified by its warning.

name: Frenzy Roar
description: Lowers its stance and announces a two-part frenzy. The roar deals no damage and does not disable the crew.

name: Frenzy: Raking Claw
description: The first separately warned strike of the frenzy sequence.

name: Frenzy: Bounding Pounce
description: The second separately warned strike; the Beast then overextends for a longer recovery.
